capabilities: Execute revisions via CLI or API.
extras: Annotations are stored as sidecar JSON in the .promptuary/annotations/ directory; original Markdown files are never modified.
intentEvidence: Existing highlight / note plugins stop at "annotation recording" — none bridge the gap from reading annotations → review comments → external AI modification.
problem: Capturing and aggregating revision notes while reading documents is difficult, and existing tools do not bridge the gap between annotations and AI-driven batch execution.
summary: A tool for capturing reading annotations and review comments, allowing users to export or execute revisions using external AI agents.
